callback_exit:
var value:i64[2]=[3,4];recursive fn run<F>(early:bool)->i64{F(copy(value),{if early{return 7;}3})}
fn main(){assert(run(true){a,n=>a[0]+n}==7);assert(run(false){a,n=>a[0]+n}==6);assert(value[0]==3);print("callback_exit");}
packed_refs:
recursive fn change(a:i64&[2]){assert(a[0] .!= a[1]);a[1]+=1;}
fn main(){var first:i64[]=[3];var second:i64[]=[4];var refs:i64&[2]=[&first[0],&second[0]];change(refs);assert(first[0]==3);assert(second[0]==5);print("packed_refs");}
